data.dream-25-0624-01|appealText: Includes an item to select 1 ★5 Idol!
data.dream-25-0624-01|precaution:
■About Gachas in the Game
- You can obtain Idols by consuming items such as Blue Diamonds, Red Diamonds, and Gacha Tickets.
- Some Gachas may be free to pull.
- Only some Idols appear. Be sure to check the drop rates.
- Idols obtained for the first time will be at Lv1.
- Idols obtainable from this Gacha may be duplicates.
- When an Idol you have already obtained appears in the Gacha, the Idol is automatically converted into Bloom Pt and Idol Medals.
- When Bloom Pt reaches the required Pt, Talent Bloom is performed automatically.
- The contents of the Gacha may change without notice.

■About "Gacha Pt"
- For Gachas eligible for "Gacha Pt", you can obtain "Gacha Pt" by pulling the Gacha.
- For details on Gachas eligible for "Gacha Pt", please check the notices.
- Idols obtainable by consuming "Gacha Pt" can be checked from [Gacha > Gacha Pt > Gacha Pt Exchange].
- For the expiration date of "Gacha Pt", please check the notices.
- Any "Gacha Pt" not used before its expiration date will be converted into "Common Gacha Pt" that can be used at [Exchange > Gacha Pt Exchange] after this Gacha's period ends.

■About "Talent Bloom Pt"
- For Gachas eligible for "Talent Bloom Pt", only when you obtain a featured Idol can you obtain 100Pt of the "Dedicated Bloom Pt" for the obtained target Idol as a set item.
- For details on Gachas eligible for "Talent Bloom Pt", please check the notices.
- If the "Dedicated Bloom Pt" exceeds the maximum Talent Bloom Pt the target Idol can hold, it will be converted into "Bloom Pieces" when received from Gifts.

■About Idols Excluding Some
- Some Idols come with a "Costume" as a set when obtained.

■About Birthday-limited Idols
- Obtaining a Birthday-limited Idol lets you obtain a "Hairstyle" as a set.
- The "Hairstyle" may not be combinable with some Costumes.
- Birthday-limited Idols do not have the set "Costume", "Home Conversations", or "Messages & Phone".

■About Situation Illustrations
- Obtaining a Situation Illustration only lets you obtain its "Illustration" and "Skill".
- Situation Illustrations do not have the set "Costume", "Home Conversations", "Messages & Phone", or "Idol Story".

■About the Gacha System
(1) Each pull is a lottery based on the drop rate.
(2) When pulling the Gacha multiple times, each pull is drawn based on the drop rate without considering the previous results.
- Gachas that can be pulled only once a day can be pulled only with Blue Diamonds.
- Gachas that can be pulled only once a day reset every day at 0:00.
- Drop rates differ for each Idol.
- Each drop rate is displayed with the fourth decimal place truncated, so the total may not equal 100%.
- For the Gacha's drop rates, be sure to check the drop rates in the Gacha details.
- Depending on the communication status with the server, the Gacha presentation or results screen may not display properly, but the Idols have been obtained normally.
- The history of each Gacha can be checked from "Gacha History".

■About Gachas in the Game
- You can obtain Idols by consuming items such as Blue Diamonds, Red Diamonds, and Gacha Tickets.
- Some Gachas may be free to pull.
- Only some Idols appear. Be sure to check the drop rates.
- Idols obtained for the first time will be at Lv1.
- Idols obtainable from this Gacha may be duplicates.
- When an Idol you have already obtained appears in the Gacha, the Idol is automatically converted into Bloom Pt and Idol Medals.
- When Bloom Pt reaches the required Pt, Talent Bloom is performed automatically.
- The contents of the Gacha may change without notice.

■About "Gacha Pt"
- For Gachas eligible for "Gacha Pt", you can obtain "Gacha Pt" by pulling the Gacha.
- For details on Gachas eligible for "Gacha Pt", please check the notices.
- Idols obtainable by consuming "Gacha Pt" can be checked from [Gacha > Gacha Pt > Gacha Pt Exchange].
- For the expiration date of "Gacha Pt", please check the notices.
- Any "Gacha Pt" not used before its expiration date will be converted into "Common Gacha Pt" that can be used at [Exchange > Gacha Pt Exchange] after this Gacha's period ends.

■About "Talent Bloom Pt"
- For Gachas eligible for "Talent Bloom Pt", only when you obtain a featured Idol can you obtain 100Pt of the "Dedicated Bloom Pt" for the obtained target Idol as a set item.
- For details on Gachas eligible for "Talent Bloom Pt", please check the notices.
- If the "Dedicated Bloom Pt" exceeds the maximum Talent Bloom Pt the target Idol can hold, it will be converted into "Bloom Pieces" when received from Gifts.

■About Idols Excluding Some
- Some Idols come with a "Costume" as a set when obtained.

■About Birthday-limited Idols
- Obtaining a Birthday-limited Idol lets you obtain a "Hairstyle" as a set.
- The "Hairstyle" may not be combinable with some Costumes.
- Birthday-limited Idols do not have the set "Costume", "Home Conversations", or "Messages & Phone".

■About Situation Illustrations
- Obtaining a Situation Illustration only lets you obtain its "Illustration" and "Skill".
- Situation Illustrations do not have the set "Costume", "Home Conversations", "Messages & Phone", or "Idol Story".

■About the Gacha System
(1) Each pull is a lottery based on the drop rate.
(2) When pulling the Gacha multiple times, each pull is drawn based on the drop rate without considering the previous results.
- Gachas that can be pulled only once a day can be pulled only with Blue Diamonds.
- Gachas that can be pulled only once a day reset every day at 0:00.
- Drop rates differ for each Idol.
- Each drop rate is displayed with the fourth decimal place truncated, so the total may not equal 100%.
- For the Gacha's drop rates, be sure to check the drop rates in the Gacha details.
- Depending on the communication status with the server, the Gacha presentation or results screen may not display properly, but the Idols have been obtained normally.
- The history of each Gacha can be checked from "Gacha History".

- By consuming the item "Free Gacha Tickets", you can pull a Gacha for free.
- Only some Idols appear. Be sure to check the drop rates.
- Idols obtained for the first time from the Gacha will be at Lv1.
- Some Idols come with a "Costume" as a set when obtained.

- When Bloom Pt reaches the required Pt, Talent Bloom is performed automatically.
- This Gacha's period may change without notice.
- The item "Free Gacha Tickets" has an expiration date of up to 7 days after acquisition.
※You cannot obtain "Gacha Pt" from this Gacha.
※This Gacha is not a "Gacha with Talent Bloom Pt". You cannot obtain "Dedicated Bloom Pt" through pickups or exchange.

■About the Gacha System
(1) Each pull is a lottery based on the drop rate.
(2) When pulling the Gacha multiple times, each pull is drawn based on the drop rate without considering the previous results.
- Drop rates differ for each Idol.
- Each drop rate is displayed with the fourth decimal place truncated, so the total may not equal 100%.
- For this Gacha's drop rates, be sure to check the drop rates in the Gacha details.
- Depending on the communication status with the server, the Gacha presentation or results screen may not display properly, but the Idols have been obtained normally.
- The history of each Gacha can be checked from "Gacha History".

data.gacha-free-ticket-1s-24-0720|precaution:
■About Gachas in the Game
- You can obtain Idols by consuming items such as Blue Diamonds, Red Diamonds, and Gacha Tickets.
- Some Gachas may be free to pull.
- Only some Idols appear. Be sure to check the drop rates.
- Idols obtained for the first time will be at Lv1.
- Idols obtainable from this Gacha may be duplicates.
- When an Idol you have already obtained appears in the Gacha, the Idol is automatically converted into Bloom Pt and Idol Medals.
- When Bloom Pt reaches the required Pt, Talent Bloom is performed automatically.
- The contents of the Gacha may change without notice.


■About "Gacha Pt"
- For Gachas eligible for "Gacha Pt", you can obtain "Gacha Pt" by pulling the Gacha.
- For details on Gachas eligible for "Gacha Pt", please check the notices.
- Idols obtainable by consuming "Gacha Pt" can be checked from [Gacha > Gacha Pt > Gacha Pt Exchange].
- For the expiration date of "Gacha Pt", please check the notices.
- Any "Gacha Pt" not used before its expiration date will be converted into "Common Gacha Pt" that can be used at [Exchange > Gacha Pt Exchange] after this Gacha's period ends.


■About "Talent Bloom Pt"
- For Gachas eligible for "Talent Bloom Pt", only when you obtain a featured Idol can you obtain 100Pt of the "Dedicated Bloom Pt" for the obtained target Idol as a set item.
- For details on Gachas eligible for "Talent Bloom Pt", please check the notices.
- If the "Dedicated Bloom Pt" exceeds the maximum Talent Bloom Pt the target Idol can hold, it will be converted into "Bloom Pieces" when received from Gifts.


■About Idols Excluding Some
- Some Idols come with a "Costume" as a set when obtained.


■About Birthday-limited Idols
- Obtaining a Birthday-limited Idol lets you obtain a "Hairstyle" as a set.
- The "Hairstyle" may not be combinable with some Costumes.
- Birthday-limited Idols do not have the set "Costume", "Home Conversations", or "Messages & Phone".


■About Situation Illustrations
- Obtaining a Situation Illustration only lets you obtain its "Illustration" and "Skill".
- Situation Illustrations do not have the set "Costume", "Home Conversations", "Messages & Phone", or "Idol Story".


■About the Gacha System
(1) Each pull is a lottery based on the drop rate.
(2) When pulling the Gacha multiple times, each pull is drawn based on the drop rate without considering the previous results.
- Gachas that can be pulled only once a day can be pulled only with Blue Diamonds.
- Gachas that can be pulled only once a day reset every day at 0:00.
- Drop rates differ for each Idol.
- Each drop rate is displayed with the fourth decimal place truncated, so the total may not equal 100%.
- For the Gacha's drop rates, be sure to check the drop rates in the Gacha details.
- Depending on the communication status with the server, the Gacha presentation or results screen may not display properly, but the Idols have been obtained normally.
- The history of each Gacha can be checked from "Gacha History".

- For Gachas eligible for "Talent Bloom Pt", please check the notifications.
- If "Exclusive Bloom Pt" exceeds the maximum Talent Bloom Pt the target Idol can hold, it will be converted into "Bloom Piece" when received from Gifts.

（1）Each pull is a lottery based on the drop rate.
（2）When pulling the Gacha multiple times, each pull is a lottery based on the drop rate without considering the previous result.
- A Gacha that can be pulled only once per day can be pulled only with Blue Diamonds.
- A Gacha that can be pulled only once per day resets every day at 0:00.
- The drop rate differs for each Idol.
- Because each drop rate is displayed with the 4th decimal place truncated, the total may not equal 100%.
- Be sure to check the drop rate in the Gacha details.
- Depending on the communication status with the server, the Gacha animation or result screen may not display correctly, but the Idols are obtained normally.
- The history of each Gacha can be checked from "Gacha History".

- You can obtain Idols by consuming items such as Blue Diamonds, Red Diamonds, and Gacha Tickets.

- Idols obtained for the first time will be at Lv1.
- Idols obtainable from this Gacha may be duplicates.

- When Bloom Pt reaches the required Pt, Talent Bloom is performed automatically.
- The contents of the Gacha may change without notice.

■About "Gacha Pt"
- For Gachas eligible for "Gacha Pt", you can obtain "Gacha Pt" by pulling the Gacha.
- For details on Gachas eligible for "Gacha Pt", please check the notices.
- Idols obtainable by consuming "Gacha Pt" can be checked from [Gacha > Gacha Pt > Gacha Pt Exchange].
- For the expiration date of "Gacha Pt", please check the notices.
- Any "Gacha Pt" not used before its expiration date will be converted into "Common Gacha Pt" that can be used at [Exchange > Gacha Pt Exchange] after this Gacha's period ends.

■About "Talent Bloom Pt"
- For Gachas eligible for "Talent Bloom Pt", only when you obtain a featured Idol can you obtain 100Pt of the "Dedicated Bloom Pt" for the obtained target Idol as a set item.
- For details on Gachas eligible for "Talent Bloom Pt", please check the notices.
- If the "Dedicated Bloom Pt" exceeds the maximum Talent Bloom Pt the target Idol can hold, it will be converted into "Bloom Pieces" when received from Gifts.

■About Idols Excluding Some
- Some Idols come with a "Costume" as a set when obtained.

■About Birthday-limited Idols
- Obtaining a Birthday-limited Idol lets you obtain a "Hairstyle" as a set.
- The "Hairstyle" may not be combinable with some Costumes.
- Birthday-limited Idols do not have the set "Costume", "Home Conversations", or "Messages & Phone".

■About Situation Illustrations
- Obtaining a Situation Illustration only lets you obtain its "Illustration" and "Skill".
- Situation Illustrations do not have the set "Costume", "Home Conversations", "Messages & Phone", or "Idol Story".

■About the Gacha System
(1) Each pull is a lottery based on the drop rate.
(2) When pulling the Gacha multiple times, each pull is drawn based on the drop rate without considering the previous results.
- Gachas that can be pulled only once a day can be pulled only with Blue Diamonds.
- Gachas that can be pulled only once a day reset every day at 0:00.
- Drop rates differ for each Idol.
- Each drop rate is displayed with the fourth decimal place truncated, so the total may not equal 100%.
- For the Gacha's drop rates, be sure to check the drop rates in the Gacha details.
- Depending on the communication status with the server, the Gacha presentation or results screen may not display properly, but the Idols have been obtained normally.
- The history of each Gacha can be checked from "Gacha History".
